author: Play On Tabletop
description:
Thank you deadly print studios for helping us to pull off this video. Thier effects are fantastic and really help being your minis to life!

https://deadlyprintstudio.com

The 2nd codex for 11th edition is here. 

The space marines are the iconic army for 40K and there are a lot of changes in this book. We give you our reaction to new data sheets, new rules and all the new detachments!

Plus Mitch’s hobby corner returns with a cool guide on applying decals to your miniatures.

title: New 11th Space Marine Codex Reaction. Plus! Mitch gives us a guide on how to do space marine decals.
